WITH bridge_steps AS (
        SELECT
          bu AS step_label,
          SUM(amount) AS step_value
        FROM CUBE_FACT
        WHERE version = 'actuals'
          AND account_code = 'revenue'
          
        GROUP BY bu
        ORDER BY SUM(amount) DESC
      ),
      with_running AS (
        SELECT
          step_label,
          step_value,
          SUM(step_value) OVER (
            ORDER BY step_value DESC
            ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
          ) AS running_total,
          CASE WHEN step_value >= 0 THEN 'positive' ELSE 'negative' END AS step_type,
          ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY step_value DESC) AS sort_order
        FROM bridge_steps
      )
      SELECT step_label, step_value, running_total, step_type, sort_order
      FROM with_running

      UNION ALL

      SELECT
        'Total' AS step_label,
        SUM(step_value) AS step_value,
        SUM(step_value) AS running_total,
        'total' AS step_type,
        (SELECT COUNT(*) + 1 FROM bridge_steps) AS sort_order
      FROM bridge_steps

      ORDER BY sort_order
